summary: Mobix Labs, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Vision Aerial, Inc. via two-step merger through wholly owned subsidiaries. Consideration comprises $3.0 million cash plus $12 million of Mobix Class A common stock, valued at a volume-weighted average price over 20 trading days, capped between $2.00 and $3.00 per share. The transaction is structured to qualify as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a) and is subject to customary closing conditions, including stockholder approvals and Mobix due diligence. A termination fee may be payable by Vision Aerial. Watch for stockholder vote timing and share-price collar effects on valuation.
